$description: SmallStore design tokens. Values are the ones used by the app (src/app/globals.css). Colors in rgb/rgba as used in CSS.

ink-2.use: labels, secondary text, secondary button text

line.use: hairline border of inputs and cards (as a 1px box-shadow)

brand.use: the one main action per screen, links, attach mode ring

brand-shine.use: light that runs across the main button

navy.use: photo badges (Studio, IA · Dos, site name)

glass.use: frosted product card over the video, with backdrop-blur 24px and a 1px white/20 ring

font.family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Ubuntu, "Noto Sans Arabic", sans-serif
font.numbers: tabular-nums on every price, count and score

size.field: 16px (never less on inputs: iPhone zooms the page into smaller fields)
size.label-tiny: 11px (card name and price lines, criteria labels)

radius.control: 6px (buttons, inputs, photo tiles, cards on white)
radius.sheet: 16px top corners on phones, 16px all round on wide screens

size.record-button: 64px ring 3px, inner 52px dot (red before filming, white shutter while filming)

motion.card-grow-into-sheet: 320ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) (FLIP from the card rect); close 256ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)
motion.shot-flies-to-card: 650ms cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.2, 1): scale 1 -> 1.12 at 30% -> into the card
motion.card-flash: 900ms ease-out amber ring pulse when a product is shown again
motion.reduced-motion: all of the above off under prefers-reduced-motion
